manifest.minimality_definition: Distance is the absolute change in one allowlisted integer field. A minimum edit distance is proven over the enumerated candidate space only when a verified flip exists and every enumerated candidate at a smaller distance was a conclusive no-flip. Otherwise a flip is the smallest verified flip among tested edits. A finished search with no verified flip is no-flip when every candidate was conclusive, and inconclusive due to invalid candidates when any candidate was not. This is not a minimum over other fields, tools, or untested values.
notes: The factual decision is the single baseline sample.
Candidates share that pre-fork checkpoint.
Post-fork samples are one draw each.
The oracle is recorded after the flip decision and does not order the search.
Early stop leaves later candidates untested. Exhaustive mode runs every declared candidate.
